_comment: Verified historical transactions from the Sepolia deployment of 20 March 2026. These are real, already-mined, and cost nothing to show. The demo surfaces them in the L1 pane in every mode, so a local run can still point at public Ethereum. Regenerate with: node demo/tools/verifySepolia.js

transactions.label: Deploy VotingRollupV2
transactions.note: Election genesis: the public voter Merkle root and election ID are fixed here, in public, before any vote exists.

transactions.label: Submit batch of 16 votes
transactions.note: 16 ballots, one proof, one transaction, 1,156 bytes of calldata. The postStateRoot is bit-identical to the local 16-vote run, so the pipeline is reproducible across networks.

transactions.label: End voting
transactions.note: The final state root is now immutable and publicly auditable.
